update_info: deprecated in favor of torch.onnx.export with dynamo=True
update_description: Users should use the dynamo=True option on torch.onnx.export. The torch.onnx.dynamo_export API is now deprecated.

XNNPACKQuantizer is deprecated in PyTorch and moved to ExecuTorch. Please use it from executorch.backends.xnnpack.quantizer.xnnpack_quantizer instead of torch.ao.quantization.quantizer.xnnpack_quantizer.
LRScheduler.print_lr() have been deprecated since 2.2. Please use LRScheduler.get_last_lr() to access the learning rate instead.
